headline: Tesla to Halt Cybertruck Production and Pivot to Robotaxi
summary: Elon Musk will halt production of the Cybertruck following weak sales performance, reallocating production capacity to Tesla's new robotaxi.
why: Strategic shifts in product lines at major electric vehicle manufacturers like Tesla impact manufacturing capital allocation and growth expectations.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Discontinuing a slow-selling product line to focus on autonomous vehicles changes the company's manufacturing and capital focus.
